name: Daily Ration
description: A day's food and water for one person.

penalty_lasts: until you drop enough gear and rest

name: Silver Pieces
description: Silver coins, the standard money of the settled lands: ten silver to a gold piece and ten copper to a silver piece. A full hundred coins counts as one item of Encumbrance.

name: No Armor
description: Ordinary clothing. Base Armor Class 10 before Dexterity, with no Encumbrance.

name: War Shirt
description: Light armor: AC 11. Encumbrance 0, and discreet enough for ordinary company.

name: Buff Coat
description: Light armor: AC 12. Encumbrance 0, and not obviously military.

name: Linothorax
description: Light armor: AC 13. Encumbrance 1.

name: War Robe
description: Light armor: AC 14. Encumbrance 3; layered cloth that can be worn in polite society.

name: Pieced Armor
description: Light armor: AC 14. Encumbrance 2; a patchwork of leather, horn, and metal.

name: Mail Shirt
description: Medium armor: AC 14. Encumbrance 1; not discreet, and the load penalizes physical Sneak checks.

name: Cuirass and Greaves
description: Medium armor: AC 15. Encumbrance 2; not discreet, and the load penalizes physical Sneak checks.

name: Scaled Armor
description: Medium armor: AC 16. Encumbrance 3; not discreet, and the load penalizes physical Sneak checks.

name: Mail Hauberk
description: Heavy armor: AC 16. Encumbrance 2; the load penalizes Sneak and Exert checks.

name: Plate Armor
description: Heavy armor: AC 17. Encumbrance 2; the load penalizes Sneak and Exert checks.

name: Great Armor
description: Heavy armor: AC 19. Encumbrance 3; the load penalizes Sneak and Exert checks.

name: Grand Plate
description: Heavy armor: AC 16, but proof against ordinary weapons. Non-magical melee and thrown attacks cannot hurt the wearer unless the weapon is two-handed, has Shock AC 16 or more, or the wearer is grappled. Encumbrance 3.

name: Small Shield
description: Shield: AC 13 when no better armor is worn; with armor of equal or better AC it adds +1 instead. Encumbrance 1. It also stops the first Shock each round.

name: Large Shield
description: Shield: AC 14 when no better armor is worn; with armor of equal or better AC it adds +1 instead. Encumbrance 1. It also stops the first Shock each round.

name: Hand Axe
description: One-handed axe. 1d6 damage, Shock 1 against AC 15 or less. Throwable to 10/30 feet. Encumbrance 1.

name: Axe, War
description: Two-handed war axe. 1d10 damage, Shock 3 against AC 15 or less. Encumbrance 2.

name: Blackjack
description: Small weighted club. 1d4 damage, no Shock, subtle, and easily used to leave a foe alive. Encumbrance 1.

name: Bow, Large
description: Two-handed warbow. 1d8 damage, range 100/600 feet, no Shock. Encumbrance 2.

name: Bow, Small
description: Two-handed hunting bow. 1d6 damage, range 50/300 feet, no Shock. Encumbrance 1.

name: Claw Blades
description: Strapped claw weapons. 1d6 damage, Shock 2 against AC 13 or less, easily concealed. Encumbrance 1.

name: Club
description: A length of wood. 1d4 damage, no Shock, throwable to 10/30 feet, easily used to leave a foe alive. Encumbrance 1.

name: Club, Great
description: A heavy two-handed club. 1d10 damage, Shock 2 against AC 15 or less. Encumbrance 2.

name: Crossbow
description: Two-handed crossbow. 1d10 damage, range 100/300 feet, no Shock. Reloading takes a Main Action. Encumbrance 1.

name: Dagger
description: A short blade. 1d4 damage, Shock 1 against AC 15 or less, throwable to 30/60 feet. Encumbrance 1.

name: Halberd
description: Two-handed polearm. 1d10 damage, Shock 2 against AC 15 or less, and reaches targets up to 10 feet away. Encumbrance 2.

name: Hammer, Great
description: Two-handed maul. 1d10 damage, Shock 2 against AC 18 or less. Encumbrance 2.

name: Hammer, War
description: One-handed war hammer. 1d8 damage, Shock 1 against AC 18 or less. Encumbrance 1.

name: Hurlant, Great
description: A siege hurlant. 3d10 damage, range 600/2400 feet, no Shock. It must be fixed in place and entrenched for five minutes before firing. Encumbrance 15.

name: Hurlant, Hand
description: A hand-held energy weapon. 1d12 damage, range 30/60 feet, no Shock. Reloading takes ten rounds. Encumbrance 1.

name: Hurlant, Long
description: A two-handed long hurlant. 2d8 damage, range 200/600 feet, no Shock. Reloading takes ten rounds. Encumbrance 2.

name: Mace
description: A one-handed mace. 1d6 damage, Shock 1 against AC 18 or less, easily used to leave a foe alive. Encumbrance 1.

name: Pike
description: A long two-handed spear. 1d8 damage, Shock 1 against AC 18 or less, reaching targets up to 10 feet away. Encumbrance 2.

name: Shield Bash, Large
description: A blow with a large shield. 1d6 damage, Shock 1 against AC 13 or less, and easily non-lethal.

name: Shield Bash, Small
description: A blow with a small shield. 1d4 damage, no Shock, and easily non-lethal.

name: Spear, Heavy
description: A two-handed spear. 1d10 damage, Shock 2 against AC 15 or less. Encumbrance 2.

name: Light Spear
description: A one-handed spear that can be thrown. 1d6 damage, Shock 2 against AC 13 or less, range 30/60 feet. Encumbrance 1.

name: Throwing Blade
description: A balanced throwing knife. 1d4 damage, no Shock, range 30/60 feet. Five count as one Readied item. Encumbrance 1.

name: Staff
description: A two-handed staff. 1d6 damage, Shock 1 against AC 13 or less, easily used to leave a foe alive. Encumbrance 1.

name: Stiletto
description: A narrow thrusting blade. 1d4 damage, Shock 1 against AC 18 or less, easily concealed, and good for Execution Attacks. Encumbrance 1.

name: Sword, Great
description: A two-handed greatsword. 1d12 damage, Shock 2 against AC 15 or less. Encumbrance 2.

name: Sword, Long
description: A one-handed longsword. 1d8 damage, Shock 2 against AC 13 or less. Encumbrance 1.

name: Short Sword
description: A one-handed short sword. 1d6 damage, Shock 2 against AC 15 or less. Encumbrance 1.

name: Unarmed Attack
description: Fists, feet, and natural weapons. 1d2 damage plus your Punch skill, no Shock by default, and easily non-lethal.

name: Arrows, 20
description: Twenty arrows. Encumbrance 1.

name: Backpack
description: A pack for stowing gear. Encumbrance 1, but none while worn.

name: Boots
description: Sturdy boots. Encumbrance 1, but none while worn.

name: Candle
description: A candle, 2 cp in the book. Effectively weightless in modest numbers.

name: Cart, One-Horse
description: A cart and its harness. Not carried as an item.

name: Clothes, Common
description: Ordinary clothing. Encumbrance 1, but none while worn.

name: Clothes, Fine
description: Well-made clothing. Encumbrance 1, but none while worn.

name: Clothes, Noble
description: Noble dress. Encumbrance 2, but none while worn.

name: Cooking Utensils
description: Pots, pans, and a cooking knife. Encumbrance 1.

name: Crowbar
description: An iron pry bar. Encumbrance 1.

name: Firewood
description: One night's fire, 2 cp in the book. Encumbrance 4.

name: Flask, Metal
description: A one-pint metal flask. Encumbrance 1.

name: Grappling Hook
description: A three-pronged hook for ropes. Encumbrance 1.

name: Hammer or Small Tool
description: A hammer or similar small tool. Encumbrance 1.

name: Healer's Pouch
description: Bandages, salves, and simple instruments for first aid. Encumbrance 1.

name: Hurlant Bolts, 20
description: Twenty hurlant bolts. Encumbrance 1.

name: Iron Spikes, 10
description: Ten iron spikes for doors and pitons. Encumbrance 1.

name: Lantern
description: A hooded oil lantern. Encumbrance 1.

name: Mirror, Hand
description: A small polished steel mirror. Weightless in modest numbers.

name: Oil, One Pint
description: Lamp oil. Encumbrance 1; three flasks bundle as one item.

name: Paper, 10 Sheets
description: Ten sheets of writing paper. Weightless in modest numbers.

name: Rations, One Week
description: A week of preserved food. Encumbrance 4.
A day's food and water for one person. Encumbrance 1.

name: Rope, 50 ft
description: Fifty feet of hemp rope. Encumbrance 2.

name: Sack
description: A canvas sack. Encumbrance 1.

name: Shovel or Pick
description: A digging tool. Encumbrance 2.

name: Tinder Box
description: Flint, steel, and dry tinder. Weightless in modest numbers.

name: Torch
description: A burning torch, 2 cp in the book. Encumbrance 1; three bundle as one.

name: Waterskin
description: A one-gallon waterskin. Encumbrance 1.

name: Writing Kit
description: Ink, pens, and a writing board. Encumbrance 1.

name: Mule
description: A pack mule. Not carried as an item.

name: Horse, Riding
description: A riding horse. Not carried as an item.

name: Horse, Draft
description: A draft horse. Not carried as an item.

name: Horse, Battle-Trained
description: A warhorse trained for battle. Not carried as an item.

name: Dog, Working
description: A working dog. Not carried as an item.
